segments.sn14.38:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“catasso imā, bhikkhave, dhātuyo.
segments.sn14.38:1.5: Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti … pe … pajānanti … pe … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī”ti.
